# World Builders

> An illustrated nonfiction book teaching history, science, philosophy, and strategy through the worlds of 18 remarkable people.

World Builders is a book by Greg Gurmai that explores the lives and ideas of extraordinary individuals who shaped our world. Each chapter dives into a different "world builder" — from scientists and philosophers to strategists and leaders — revealing the principles and patterns that drive human progress.
